requirement.normalizedRequirement: When the local-frame area exceeds the attached-plate-flange area, z_na = (100*A_fn + h_w*t_wn - 1000*t_pn*s)/(2*t_wn) [mm]. The net effective plastic section modulus is Z_p = t_pn*s*(z_na + t_pn/2)*sin(phi_w) + (((h_w - z_na)^2 + z_na^2)*t_wn*sin(phi_w))/2000 + A_fn*((h_fc - z_na)*sin(phi_w) - b_w*cos(phi_w))/10 [cm^3]. For oblique framing (70 deg > Omega > 20 deg), use linear interpolation.
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: When the cross-sectional area of the local frame exceeds the cross-sectional area of the attached plate flange, the plastic neutral axis is z_na = (100*A_fn + h_w*t_wn - 1000*t_pn*s)/(2*t_wn) [mm], and the net effective plastic section modulus is Z_p = t_pn*s*(z_na + t_pn/2)*sin(phi_w) + (((h_w - z_na)^2 + z_na^2)*t_wn*sin(phi_w))/2000 + A_fn*((h_fc - z_na)*sin(phi_w) - b_w*cos(phi_w))/10 [cm^3]. For oblique framing (70 deg > Omega > 20 deg), linear interpolation is to be used.
